drive: sh -c 'd=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf \"$d\"" EXIT; ln -s "$PWD" "$d/factonio"; env -u HERMES_DELEGATED_CHILD_CONTEXT PYTHONPATH="$d${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v'
evidence: Record every command with its exit code and the last lines of stdout/stderr.
Keep the unittest summary line (`Ran N tests` / `OK`) and any FAIL/ERROR tracebacks.
Keep the `harness check` JSON (`valid`, `errors`, `hook_results`) and the `harness audit` JSON (`severity`, `drifted`).
For Desktop UI changes, capture screenshots via tools/capture_readme_media.py --qa-dir into a temp dir.
cleanup: Remove any temporary checkouts, QA media directories, and scratch kanban databases created during Drive.
Never point a real ~/.hermes profile's plugins/factonio link at the checkout under test.
